   - **Cons**: It has the heaviest operational footprint among the three candidates, requiring a commercial tier for the module ecosystem and adding complexity with its module system. Self-hosted HA deployment for our workload would cost approximately $60,000/year. Its operational complexity and cost may make it less ideal compared to other options like Qdrant, which offers better performance and lower operational overhead within the same budget.

Based on these findings, Qdrant and Weaviate are both strong candidates, but Qdrant may be more suitable due to its better performance and lower operational overhead within the same budget. However, the choice ultimately depends on the specific needs and constraints of the project.
